kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أبتسر (form VIII)
# أَبْتَسِرُ (ʔabtasiru) /ʔab.ta.si.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# أُبْتَسَرُ (ʔubtasaru) /ʔub.ta.sa.ru/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# أَبْتَسِرَ (ʔabtasira) /ʔab.ta.si.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَسَرَ (ibtasara)
# أُبْتَسَرَ (ʔubtasara) /ʔub.ta.sa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
